scope: Codex browser interactions with real isolated FastAPI/SQLite and bounded inspection/extraction workers; one synthetic static form/table PDF; no model inference.
checks: Bounded form evidence inspection leaves complete saved page unchanged
Unmapped saved field blocks apply in the browser
Identical refresh preserves complete page, revision, approved source and reviewer note
Manual table created through frontend and API with exact selected native region replacements
New cells remain unreadable and unapproved; original extraction and detector proposal are archived
Existing reviewed form source and note survive unrelated manual-table creation
limitations: Synthetic fixture only; no general recognition or translation accuracy measured.
